name: Barbell row
notes: Bent-over row from a braced hinge position.

guide.setup: Hold the bar just outside the legs, hinge until the torso is roughly 30 to 45 degrees from the floor, and brace.
guide.execution: Pull the bar toward the lower ribs, pause, and lower without changing the torso angle.
guide.cues: Keep the neck long. Pull elbows toward the hips. Let the back move the bar.
guide.mistakes: Standing up each rep; shrugging; bouncing the torso; rounding the lower back.
